notes: Second-pass COVER-only research for 19 published Georgian universities whose cover_image_url is empty, carried out 2026-09-16. Method: (1) grepped the July 2026 alphabetical pass (a-*.json and second-pass-patches/patch-*.json) for every slug so dead ends were not repeated; (2) fetched each institution's own domain with curl (desktop UA), including Georgian-language paths, campus/infrastructure/gallery/contact subpages, Next.js/React SPA JSON APIs (seu.edu.ge -> cc.seu.edu.ge/api/photos; newvision.ge -> api.newvision.ge Umbraco delivery API) and CSS background-image declarations; (3) downloaded every plausible candidate and visually inspected it before nominating; (4) searched Wikimedia Commons via the API in English and Georgian for all named institutions - zero usable campus photographs exist there (only two logo files, File:GRUNI.png and File:Logo of New Vision University.png), so Commons is a dead end for this cohort. Bar applied (relaxed vs. the July pass): an official photograph published on the institution's own domain of that institution's own building/campus/facility; exteriors preferred, a clearly-identified interior of the institution's own facility accepted as a last resort. Rejected on sight: logos/wordmarks used as og:image, designed marketing composites with text overlay, graduation/ceremony/news-event photos, posed portraits of people, stock imagery (e.g. gruni.edu.ge medical_2016.jpg carries EXIF copyright 'everythingpossible - Fotolia'; newvision.ge school-cover 4 and 7 are abstract stock composites), and generic city-of-Tbilisi/Kutaisi tourism shots. Three identity questions the July pass left open were resolved this pass: ccmi.edu.ge IS 'Critical Care Medicine Institute | Tbilisi, Georgia'; iut.edu.ge IS 'Tbilisi International University' (medicine, dentistry and physiotherapy programmes) and matches the 'International University of Tbilisi School of Health' record; unik.edu.ge 301-redirects to cue.edu.ge, confirming Kutaisi University == Central University of Europe and therefore that 'kutaisi-institute-of-medicine' duplicates 'central-university-of-europe'. Every sourceUrl below was verified in this session with curl -sIL and returns HTTP 200 with an image/* content-type; no URL was guessed or reconstructed. No uploads, no database writes, no scripts run.

entries.reason: Re-checked alte.edu.ge in Georgian and English: homepage, /ka/universiteti-erti-shekhedvit, /ka/sauniversiteto-tsentrebi, /ka/galerea, /ka/kampus-turi and /ka/sivrtseebi-ghonisdziebebistvis. The site is a Next.js app whose gallery is client-rendered; /api/gallery, /api/galleries and /api/page/galerea all 404, so only the images embedded in server-rendered markup are reachable. Every one of those is a marketing asset, not a campus photograph: /api/storage/og_image/alte-universiteti.jpg and /img/alte-university-default.jpg are the logo on a flat background; /api/storage/gallery/RrCA6b4KVO.webp and jcbbLMpcvY.webp (3749x2800 / 3738x2800) are the same posed studio shot of four students in front of the interior lobby signage with large 'EDUCATION FOR CONSTANT DEVELOPMENT' / Georgian slogan text burned in; /api/storage/gallery/-6.webp, -289.webp and xbP28biGzP.webp (all 1920x752) are advertising banners (typographic promo panel; a six-up grid of cast members from a TV-style campaign). No exterior of the building and no unbranded interior of an Alte facility is published anywhere reachable on the domain. Wikimedia Commons has nothing under 'Alte University' or 'ალტე უნივერსიტეტი'.

cover.rightsBasis: Official institutional image served from Caucasus University's own domain (cu.edu.ge), published in the 'CU CAMPUS' gallery on the university's own campus page https://cu.edu.ge/about-us/cu-campus; depicts an aerial exterior view of the Caucasus University campus in Tbilisi - the historic stone main building, forecourt, fountain, grounds and sports pitch - which is the campus the Caucasus Medicine School (a school of Caucasus University, cu.edu.ge/en/schoolss/chs, NOT Caucasus International University) sits on; no photographer watermark, unlike several other files in the same gallery which carry a '(c) Photo courtesy of KOM Hive' credit and were therefore avoided; verified HTTP 200 image/jpeg, 967x1080 px (portrait-leaning, so a landscape crop across the building band will be needed for cover use)

entries.universityName: Central University of Europe Faculty of Medicine

cover.rightsBasis: Official institutional image served from the university's own WordPress media library (cue.edu.ge), published in the photo set on the university's own 'About the Tbilisi campus' page https://cue.edu.ge/chvens-shesaxeb/tbilisis-campusis-shesaxeb/; depicts the faculty's own teaching laboratory on the Tbilisi campus - benches with sinks, fume cabinet, analyser and glassware, no people; accepted as a last-resort interior because no exterior of the building is published anywhere on the domain (the homepage hero CoverWebMedic.jpg is a designed blue composite with a Tbilisi skyline silhouette, slide1-banner.webp is an outdoor graduation ceremony, and the Kutaisi page only carries city-tourism stock such as Kutaisi_Golden_morning.jpg and Kutaisi_airport_interior_information.jpg); verified HTTP 200 image/jpeg, 1200x800 px (a -scaled.jpg original also exists at the same path)

entries.reason: Unresolved identity - no media can be attributed. Searched in English ('Classical and Traditional Medicine Academy' Tbilisi Georgia) and probed plausible Georgian domains (ctma.edu.ge - DNS resolution failure). Web search surfaces no official site: results are other institutions entirely (Tbilisi Medical Academy, Tbilisi State Medical University, Georgian International Academy) plus MBBS-abroad directory listings that merely repeat the name. Wikimedia Commons API returns nothing for the name in English or Georgian. Consistent with the July 2026 pass, which also flagged this as an unresolved-identity record rather than a missing-asset one. Until the legal institution name and official domain are confirmed there is no domain to source an official photograph from, and nothing should be attached.

Identity RESOLVED this pass (correcting the July 2026 'unresolved identity' finding): https://www.ccmi.edu.ge/ returns HTTP 200 with <title>Critical Care Medicine Institute | Tbilisi, Georgia</title>. However no usable cover exists on it. The site is a small Wix build; its entire image inventory, harvested from the Georgian homepage, the /en page and the /სტრუქტურა pages, is four files on static.wixstatic.com: three UI icons (adress.png, websites.png, chat/phone/mail glyphs), the institute logo (logo.png), and one photograph, Capture_PNG.png (1007x439). That photograph is a panoramic lobby interior whose reception signage reads 'TBILISI CENTRAL HOSPITAL' - it depicts the affiliated hospital's building, a separate legal entity, not the institute's own premises, so publishing it as the institute's campus cover would be a misattribution. No gallery, campus, infrastructure or press page exists on the domain; Wikimedia Commons has nothing. Recommend recording ccmi.edu.ge as the official domain on the record, but holding the cover.

entries.universityName: David Tvildiani Medical University AIETI Medical School

Everything published is promotional rather than a campus photograph: the homepage hero /storage/app/uploads/public/6a2/ff4/95b/thumb_13546_1920_800_0_0_crop.png is a graduation-ceremony shot with an 'ACT TO WIN / GRANTS - SCHOLARSHIPS / 95%' marketing overlay; the other slider backgrounds (6a8d5e87cf1c8663357255.jpg, 6a9dd2c24cd53198497067.jpg, 6a8d5df1593d8733012140.jpeg) are square 1200x1200/960x960 social-media promo tiles; /storage/app/media/pageImages/Campus.jpg, despite its filename, is a collage of eight small snapshots of students at indoor events; /storage/app/uploads/public/5c7/eed/f24/5c7eedf24f457591153208.jpg is a decorative carved-stone texture strip. cover.rightsBasis: Official institutional image served from the university's own content backend (cc.seu.edu.ge, the API host seu.edu.ge's SPA loads all site media from); it is photo 30 of the university's own 'SEU Campus' / 'SEU-ს კამპუსი' gallery, category 58 of https://cc.seu.edu.ge/api/photos; depicts the SEU Blockchain Lab on the SEU campus - the room is empty of people and every monitor displays the SEU wordmark wallpaper, with 'SEU BLOCKCHAIN LAB' and partner logos on the end wall, so the facility is unambiguously identified as SEU's own; accepted as a last-resort interior because the SEU Campus gallery contains no exterior of the building (its other frames are a decorated atrium ice rink, library/auditorium/lecture-hall interiors with students, a dental simulation clinic and welcome-party crowd shots); verified HTTP 200 image/jpeg, 756x425 px landscape - below the 1000 px preference, which is the maximum the gallery serves. CAVEAT for the integrator: the July 2026 pass flagged this slug as a duplicate of 'seu-georgian-national-university'; the canonical-record decision should be made before the same asset is uploaded twice.

entries.universityName: Grigol Robakidze University School of Medicine
entries.reason: Walked gruni.edu.ge: homepage, the contact page, the sitemap, all six /schools/index/* school pages (the medicine school is id 1442824513) and the /other_content and /menu_content about pages. Nothing on the domain is a usable campus photograph. The only site-chrome photographs, /assets/bottomslider/images/1-4.jpg, are 220x124 px thumbnails (one is a night-time street scene) - far too small for a cover. The school header banners under /uploads/images/Schools/School Header Banners/ are 1600x82 px decorative strips, and /uploads/images/Other_Page/gruniverse/gruniverse.jpg is 1600x160. Critically, /uploads/images/Schools/School thumbs/medical_2016.jpg - the medicine school's own thumbnail - carries the EXIF copyright string 'everythingpossible - Fotolia', i.e. it is licensed stock photography, not an image of the university, and must not be used. The remaining /uploads/images/ content is news-article covers and staff/blog portraits. Wikimedia Commons holds only File:GRUNI.png, a logo, no campus photograph.

entries.universityName: International University of Tbilisi School of Health

cover.rightsBasis: Official institutional image served from the institution's own WordPress media library (iut.edu.ge), published in the university's own photo gallery at https://iut.edu.ge/abiturientebisatvis/potogalerea/; depicts the university's clinical-skills simulation ward - hospital beds with patient manikins, ventilator and defibrillator trolleys, wheelchair - which is directly relevant to the School of Health record; accepted as a last-resort interior because the institution publishes no exterior of its building (the 15-frame gallery is entirely indoor: lecture rooms, board room, moot court, anatomy museum, physiotherapy room, simulated operating theatre, student lounge); verified HTTP 200 image/jpeg, 1280x960 px landscape. IDENTITY NOTE for the integrator: the July 2026 pass could not locate this institution. iut.edu.ge resolves and self-describes throughout its Georgian markup as 'თბილისის საერთაშორისო უნივერსიტეტი' (Tbilisi International University), running accredited medicine, dentistry, physiotherapy and Georgian-language programmes - this is the institution behind the record, and iut.edu.ge should be recorded as its official domain.

entries.reason: Identity clarified but cover still unavailable, and the record is very likely a duplicate. Probed kum.edu.ge and kim.edu.ge (both DNS resolution failure) and unik.edu.ge, which returns HTTP 200 after a redirect to https://cue.edu.ge/ - confirming that Kutaisi University now operates as Central University of Europe and that this record duplicates 'central-university-of-europe' in this same batch. CUE's own Kutaisi page, https://cue.edu.ge/chvens-shesaxeb/kutaisis-shesaxeb/, publishes no photograph of the Kutaisi campus at all: its images are city-of-Kutaisi tourism shots (Kutaisi_Golden_morning.jpg, Kutaisi_airport_interior_information.jpg, Things-to-do-in-Kutaisi-39-of-430.jpg) plus Facebook-sourced event snapshots, none of which is a campus photograph. The Tbilisi-campus laboratory image nominated for the central-university-of-europe entry depicts the Tbilisi site and must not be reused here as a Kutaisi cover. Needs the duplicate-record decision before any media is attached.

entries.universityName: New Vision University School of Medicine
